# n8n_credential_twilio_api (Resource)

Manages an n8n Twilio API credential (`twilioApi`) via the Public API.

Set `auth_type` to `authToken` (with `auth_token`) or `apiKey` (with `api_key_sid` and `api_key_secret`). `account_sid` is always required. Secrets are write-only. Terraform 1.11 or later is required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "n8n_credential_twilio_api" "example" {
  name              = "twilio"
  auth_type         = "authToken"
  account_sid       = "ACxxxxxxxx"
  auth_token        = "placeholder"
  data_version      = 1
  delete_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_sid` (String) Twilio Account SID.
- `auth_type` (String) Auth type: `authToken` or `apiKey`.
- `data_version` (Number) Keeper for write-only secrets. Create always sends credential data. Update sends data when this value changes or when a non-secret payload attribute changes.
- `delete_protection` (Boolean) When set to `true`, prevents Terraform from destroying this credential. This flag is Terraform-only; n8n has no matching API field. Imported resources default to `true`.
- `name` (String) Credential name.

### Optional

- `api_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) Twilio API Key Secret used when auth_type is apiKey. Write-only; never stored in state.
- `api_key_sid` (String, Sensitive) Twilio API Key SID used when auth_type is apiKey. Write-only; never stored in state.
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Twilio Auth Token used when auth_type is authToken. Write-only; never stored in state.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this credential is available globally. Applied after create via update. Community n8n returns 403 when set to true.
- `is_partial_data` (Boolean) When true, n8n merges payload fields into the stored secret object on update. When false, the payload replaces the entire object. OAuth types default to true so omitted oauth_token_data does not wipe UI-obtained tokens.
- `is_resolvable` (Boolean) Whether this credential has resolvable fields.
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the credential. Omit to use the API key owner's personal project. Changing a previously set value transfers the credential; setting it for the first time after import adopts without transfer.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from n8n.
- `id` (String) Credential ID assigned by n8n.
- `is_managed` (Boolean) Whether n8n manages this credential. Managed credentials cannot be edited or deleted via the API.
- `resolvable_allow_fallback` (Boolean) Whether a credential resolver may fall back to static data.
- `resolver_id` (String) Dynamic credential resolver id, if any.
- `type` (String) n8n credential type (`twilioApi`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp from n8n.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import n8n_credential_twilio_api.example <credential-id>
```
